freq1.Description: Lower frequency (F1) used to produce distortion product otoacoustic emissions. The F2/F1 ratio = 1,22.

freq2.Description: Higher frequency (F2) used to produce distortion product otoacoustic emissions. The F2/F1 ratio = 1,22.

dp.Description: Measured level of the distortion product otoacoustic emissions.

snr.Description: Difference between the measured level of the distortion product otoacoustic emissions and the measured noise relative strength plus two standard deviations (TEOAE level - (Noise level + 2 * SD)).

noise+2sd.LongName: Noise level plus two standard deviations
noise+2sd.Description: Measured noise relative strength level plus two standard deviations.

noise+1sd.Description: Measured noise relative strength level plus one standard deviation.

2f2-f1.Description: Frequency #2 intensity times two minus frequency #1 intensity (2 * F2 - F1).

3f1-2f2.LongName: Frequency #1 times three minus frequency #2 times two
3f1-2f2.Description: Frequency #1 intensity times three minus frequency #2 times two (3 * F1 - 2 * F2).

3f2-2f1.LongName: Frequency #2 times three minus frequency #1 times two
3f2-2f1.Description: Frequency #2 intensity times three minus frequency #1 times two (3 * F2 - 2 * F1).

4f1-3f2.LongName: Frequency #1 times four minus frequency #2 times three
4f1-3f2.Description: Frequency #1 intensity times four minus frequency #2 times three (4 * F1 - 3 * F2).
